product: Anthropic-hosted Claude Code cloud sessions (Claude Code on the web, claude.ai/code) incl. Routines research preview
account_scope: not checked; requires claude.ai Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise with allow_remote_sessions, not ZDR/HIPAA
non_qualifying_surfaces: claude_agent_sdk local lane (MP-07) and claude -p on our worker
agent view / background agents (claude agents --json, attach, logs, stop, rm, respawn): local only
Projects and all claude.ai web/desktop/mobile UI actions
Compliance API remote sessions: Cowork only, Claude Code cloud sessions explicitly excluded
browser automation, scraped session cookies, private web-app endpoints

launch.invocation: A: claude --cloud "<task>" (interactive; no documented machine-readable create output; CCR_FORCE_BUNDLE=1 uploads git bundle). B: POST https://api.anthropic.com/v1/claude_code/routines/{trig_id}/fire headers Authorization: Bearer sk-ant-oat01-..., anthropic-version: 2023-06-01; body {"text": string<=65536}; returns {type:"routine_fire", claude_code_session_id, claude_code_session_url}
launch.auth_mode: A: claude.ai subscription OAuth (claude auth login), API keys and 3P providers refused. B: per-routine bearer token created only in web UI, one routine, no read access
launch.idempotency: none: /fire documents no idempotency key and retries create duplicate sessions; CLI create has none; no list/lookup to reconcile ambiguous creates
launch.failure_retention: /fire 400/401/403/404/429(Retry-After; 30/h/routine, 100/h/account)/500/503; routine must be pre-built in UI, clones default branch, no permission-mode picker, fire text wrapped as untrusted; CLI: Session creation failed, Not uploading this working tree, org policy errors

inspect_status.failure_retention: no status endpoint for Claude Code cloud sessions; Compliance remote-session endpoints exclude them; claude agents --json is local-only; /fire token has no read access; VMs pause after idle minutes and may be reclaimed without any readable signal

observe_replay.invocation: push-only: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY=1 + OTEL_* on the cloud environment variables or org server-managed settings env; collector host allowed in environment network policy; optional repo-committed type:http hooks (PostToolUse, Stop, SubagentStop, SessionEnd) in single-repo sessions
observe_replay.auth_mode: none toward Anthropic; collector credentials only via server-managed settings (env vars are readable by all environment users; network secrets never attach to telemetry export)
observe_replay.idempotency: consumer-side dedupe on (ccr.session.id, message.uuid|tool_use_id, event); export best-effort with no cursor
observe_replay.failure_retention: no replay: missed exports are lost; only transcript retrieval is interactive claude --teleport (local copy); Compliance transcripts exclude Claude Code cloud sessions

follow_up.invocation: claude -p "<msg>" --cloud <session_...|cse_...|claude.ai/code URL> --output-format json (or stdin); queues and exits; stream-json unsupported with --cloud <id>
follow_up.auth_mode: claude.ai account via claude auth login on any machine; setup-token/CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN applicability undocumented
follow_up.idempotency: none; no message id; retry after ambiguous exit may double-queue; withdraw queued message is UI-only
follow_up.failure_retention: {ok:false, session_id, error} for missing/archived session; config/policy errors on stderr without JSON; ok:true proves enqueue only; reclaimed VM restores history but not background work

cancel_interrupt.failure_retention: archive/delete are claude.ai UI actions only; claude stop/kill/rm act on local background sessions; routine pause/delete UI-only; a 'stop' follow-up is a model instruction, not a control

usage.invocation: OTel metrics claude_code.cost.usage (client estimate USD), claude_code.token.usage, claude_code.active_time.total attributed by session.id/ccr.session.id; GET /v1/organizations/usage_report/claude_code?starting_at=YYYY-MM-DD daily per-actor aggregate with is_remote
usage.auth_mode: OTel push: none; usage report: Admin API key (applicability to Pro/Max unclear)
usage.idempotency: OTel cumulative counters; usage report idempotent daily read
usage.failure_retention: billed as subscription usage limits shared with all Claude usage, optional metered overage; no per-session hard budget for cloud sessions (--max-budget-usd is print-only); lost exports lose usage

output_custody.invocation: session pushes claude/-prefixed branches through GitHub proxy (no branch deletion or tags); Mission Control reads branch/commit/diff via GitHub API with its own credential; CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_SESSION_ID available in VM for stamping commits/PRs; claude --teleport <id> fetches branch locally (interactive, clean tree, same repo/account)
output_custody.auth_mode: claude.ai GitHub App or /web-setup token for the session; Mission Control GitHub credential for retrieval
output_custody.idempotency: GitHub reads idempotent; session-to-branch mapping is a convention we impose, not a provider contract
output_custody.failure_retention: unpushed work lost on VM reclaim; web diff view UI-only; non-GitHub remotes cannot receive pushes; no session output manifest API

environment_selection.invocation: /remote-env interactive picker writes remote.defaultEnvironmentId in user settings (fallback: Anthropic-hosted, then first non-bridge env); --environment accepts only ccpool_ and explicitly rejects env_ IDs; routine binds env in web form; per-invocation --settings override of remote.defaultEnvironmentId undocumented
environment_selection.failure_retention: environments created/edited/archived only in UI, never deleted; no list/get API or revision digest; setup cache rebuilt on script/allowlist change or ~7 days, uncached if >~5 min; variable edits reach existing sessions only on VM restore/rebuild

configuration_materialization.invocation: commit config to an admitted integration branch then claude --cloud from it: CLAUDE.md, .claude/rules, .claude/skills|agents|commands always; .claude/settings.json hooks/permissions/env and .mcp.json only in single-repo sessions; environment vars/setup script via UI; org server-managed settings
configuration_materialization.auth_mode: claude.ai account; org Owner for server-managed settings
configuration_materialization.idempotency: our commit sha as materialization digest; product reports no effective configuration
configuration_materialization.failure_retention: repo enabledPlugins/extraKnownMarketplaces explicitly not installed; user ~/.claude and device managed settings not applied; local --settings/--mcp-config pass-through undocumented; multi-repo sessions skip hooks/permissions/env; localhost MCP unreachable; env vars visible to all env users

approval_suspension_resume.invocation: repo-committed PreToolUse/PermissionRequest hooks incl. type:http fire in cloud sessions and return permissionDecision allow|deny|ask synchronously within hook timeout (default 600 s for http); native permission prompts and AskUserQuestion answered in claude.ai UI only
approval_suspension_resume.auth_mode: hook endpoint reachable via environment allowlist; credential handling for hook requests undocumented
approval_suspension_resume.idempotency: decision keyed by (ccr.session.id, tool_use_id) on our side
approval_suspension_resume.failure_retention: defer is explicitly honored only with -p (not available for hosted sessions); routines have no permission picker and run unattended; sessions waiting on MCP connector approval can expire; decision beyond hook timeout or across VM pause/reclaim is lost

subordinate_lineage.invocation: OTel agent_id, parent_agent_id, query_source, subagent_type, subagent spans under parent claude_code.tool; repo-committed SubagentStart/SubagentStop hooks
subordinate_lineage.failure_retention: running subagents not restored after VM reclaim; --forward-subagent-text print-only; no child-agent listing API

bounded_continuation_compaction.invocation: auto-compaction in cloud with product-set CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE; CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW env or /autocompact; /compact [focus] in session; PreCompact can block, PostCompact reports; claude -p "/compact" --cloud <id> interpretation undocumented
bounded_continuation_compaction.failure_retention: no fork/continue API; --fork-session is local; --teleport is a one-way interactive local copy; portable continuation would require new launch + artifacts

outcome_rationale: cancel_interrupt and inspect_status have no public surface, observe has no replay, and launch/follow-up have no idempotency; outcome 2 rejected because no Mission Control workflow is admissible without terminal settlement and cancel
missing_operations: create_session_with_idempotency_key(repo, ref, env_id, model, permission_mode, prompt) -> session_id (machine-readable)
get_session_status(session_id) and list_sessions(filters) with lifecycle state and in-VM CLI version
resumable_event_stream_or_paged_events(session_id, cursor) with stable event ids and documented retention
interrupt_turn(session_id) and stop_or_archive_session(session_id) with settled terminal state
send_follow_up returning message_id, accepting idempotency key, exposing read/applied state and withdraw
get_session_usage(session_id) authoritative tokens/subscription units and per-session hard budget
get_session_outputs(session_id) -> branch, base, head commit, PR URL, diff stats
list/get_environment with revision digest and non-interactive per-invocation env_ selection
per-session configuration injection (settings, MCP, hooks, skills) without git commit plus effective-config report
list_pending_approvals(session_id) and answer_approval(correlation_id, allow|deny) durable across VM pause/reclaim, or hosted defer semantics
list_subagents(session_id) with parent links and status
trigger_compaction(session_id) and fork_or_continue_session(session_id) into a new bounded session
documented scoped non-interactive automation credential for create/send/read
